messages:
incident-bot: :warning: [ALERT] Production: elevated latency + error spike on inference-gateway. Spikes concentrated on /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank; chat tail latency starting 10:12 UTC. Automated autoscale delayed.

tara: I'm joining the thread. Noted spike. Pulling top talkers.

kevin: I see 5xxs primarily from rerank workers hitting backend timeouts; embeddings requests are long-running and piling up.

neil: Paging @priya (oncall). priya: oncall here, looking. What's the customer impact?

priya: From dashboards: public embeddings p95 from 800ms -> 3.2s, rerank 5xx increase to 1.2%. Paid chat customers affected intermittently, some realtime apps seeing degradation. Marking SEV2.

tara: Quick mitigation suggestion: reduce public embeddings ingress, convert non-critical rerank calls to background async, and apply model-routing to favor smaller embedding model for public keys.

kevin: Agreed. Also consider per-key token throttles for the top noisy keys and apply a short-lived rerank circuit-breaker at the edge.

priya: I'll run mitigations in this order:
1) Apply route-level qps caps to anonymous/public on embeddings
2) Enable rerank circuit-breaker for non-paid keys (fail fast -> async job id)
3) Route public chat to small-v2 model to reduce GPU pressure
4) Post temporary per-key token caps for the top 10 noisy keys

priya: Commands I will execute now:
```
# set public embeddings qps to 25
rwctl limit route /v1/embeddings --tier public --qps 25 --reason "emergency backpressure"
# circuit-breaker: rerank -> return 202 + job id for non-paid
nrwctl circuit set --route /v1/rerank --scope non-paid --mode async-202 --threshold 400ms
# model routing change for public chat
rwctl model-route set --route /v1/chat --scope public --model small-v2 --ttl 15m
# per-key temp token cap
rwctl token-quota set --api-key key_9xY --tokens-per-minute 1500 --ttl 30m --reason "noisy-client throttle"
```

dev-bot: Commands accepted; applying policies to edge.

ops-bot: Notifying customer-ops. Template: brief advisory + affected endpoints + mitigation steps.

priya: Embeddings public qps cap pushed. Edge shows limiting headers on /v1/embeddings for many anonymous requests. Queue depth decreasing.

kevin: Rerank circuit-breaker enabled; I see 202 responses for non-paid keys with job id header. Paid keys still hitting synchronous rerank. 5xxs on rerank dropping quickly.

neil: Small-v2 routing for public chat is live. Latency dropped on those shards; overall chat p95 improving but still above SLO for a subset of premium customers — investigating.

priya: Created short list of top noisy api-keys and applied per-key caps for 30m. Some clients are running large batch embeddings at once. Reached out via account reps.

billing: Heads up — if we keep per-key caps we'll need to coordinate with sales for impacted paid customers. Are any paying customers throttled?

priya: Only anonymous/public keys and a couple borderline trial accounts. No high-tier paying customers. Account reps notified for trials.

kevin: Two follow-ups:
- If churn persists, we should enable model-fallback for rerank to a cheaper model for non-paid traffic
- Add an edge rule to reject rerank requests with payloads over 1MB for non-paid tier (those are probably batched jobs).

priya: Implementing edge rule now.

dev-bot: Edge rule applied: drop-large-payloads-nonpaid (threshold 1MB)

priya: Metrics: embeddings 95th tail down from 3.2s -> ~1.1s in 5m after caps. rerank 5xx dropped from 1.2% -> 0.25%. Chat p95 trending toward SLO.

tara: Good progress. Next steps after stabilization:
- Gradually relax qps caps in increments of 10 every 10m while watching queue depth
- Add permanent per-route token limits for anonymous tier
- Postmortem owners: tara + kevin (include noisy-neighbor detection and autoscale tuning)

priya: Handing off monitoring to kevin. My oncall window ends in 12m. Handoff notes: policies applied (emb cap public 25qps; rerank circuit-breaker non-paid async-202; model-route public chat -> small-v2; per-key token caps for top noisy keys; edge payload reject rule).

kevin: Taking over. I'll keep the caps for another 25m and then run incremental relax if stable. Opened ticket INC-2060001110 with attached mitigation traces.

ops-bot: Status page updated: "Degraded performance on embeddings and rerank endpoints; mitigation in progress". Sent targeted messages to trial customers; account reps alerted for any customers showing increased errors.

billing: For impacted trials, we should ensure clear guidance to avoid billing storms. Send a suggested email: explain throttling and recommend spreading jobs.

neil: Quick thought — add a short-term feature flag to disable synchronous rerank on public tier permanently unless key is whitelisted. Great mitigation for noisy neighbors. Add to backlog.

kevin: Noted. Creating feature flag ticket and will include in postmortem action items.

priya: Monitoring window shows stable metrics for 15m. No regressions. Will unassign oncall at end of window.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (monitoring). If errors spike again reopen.

kevin: Summary of live mitigations:
- Public embeddings qps cap -> 25
- Rerank for non-paid -> circuit-breaker async-202 (fail fast)
- Public chat routed to small-v2 model (temp)
- Per-api-key token caps for top noisy clients (30m)
- Edge reject rule for rerank payloads >1MB on non-paid

kevin: Postmortem owners: tara + kevin. Scheduled review in 48 hours. Include recommendations: per-key automatic throttling, more aggressive autoscale thresholds for embeddings, and route-specific token accounting.

priya: Thanks team. Closing my oncall. :thumbsup:

messages end
